Option_DiagnosticsNote: Collects logs and settings for troubleshooting; game files are not modified.
Option_InstallNote: Installs the mod if missing, otherwise updates it.
Option_ManageNote: Disables the installed MetaMystia mod; you can re-enable it anytime.
Option_UninstallNote: Removes the MetaMystia mod, optionally along with BepInEx.
ResourceNote: ResourceExample is a content pack provided by MetaMystia. It adds new stories, rare guests, dishes, and ingredients to the game. Install it only if you want this content.

Uninstall_LightNote: Removes only MetaMystia files; BepInEx and other mods are kept.
